fire: Born from friction, it seeks only to consume.
water: Patient and yielding, it shapes everything it touches.
earth: Old and quiet — the foundation beneath all things.
shadow: Not the absence of light, but its forgotten twin.
light: The first thing ever named, still searching for purpose.
steam: Fire and water, briefly at peace.
lava: The earth's buried rage, briefly made visible.
hellfire: A flame that feeds on souls, not wood.
radiance: Pure light given form — uncomfortable to behold directly.
mud: Earth that forgot what it was supposed to be.
murk: Water with something to hide in its depths.
holy_water: Water that passed through ground where prayers were answered.
cursed_soil: Earth that still remembers what was buried in it.
crystal: Light, frozen into perfect geometry by time and pressure.
twilight: The border between knowing and not knowing.
obsidian: Lava that changed its mind about burning.
clay: Future pottery, holding the shape of potential.
divinity: The lingering echo of something far greater.
void: The space between thoughts, given weight.
ancient_stone: Older than the word for ancient.
abyss: The darkness that stares back when you stare too long.
sacred_inferno: A fire that burns away sin, not flesh.
philosophers_stone: The oldest alchemical dream, finally made real.
forbidden_relic: Some knowledge was locked away for very good reason.
ocean: Water, discovering what happens when there is far too much of it.
sand: Earth, ground down by patience and time.
fog: Water that decided it preferred to drift.
cloud: Steam that climbed high enough to forget the earth.
plasma: Fire that evolved past its own nature.
lightning: Light in a hurry, carrying a message.
ice: Water that decided to stop moving for a while.
snow: Ice that wanted to feel lighter.
rain: The sky returning what the earth once lent it.
ash: What fire leaves behind when it is finally satisfied.
glass: Sand transformed by fire into something it never expected.
metal: Earth, refined until only the essential remains.
gold: Metal that refused to change and was rewarded for it.
iron: Metal that learned patience from the earth.
steel: Iron that decided to become something more.
spirit: Something that persists after the body forgets to.
soul: The thing that makes the difference between a body and a person.
magic: The universe bending its own rules, just this once.
life: The temporary victory of order over entropy.
death: Order's long defeat, returning to entropy.
darkness: Shadow given total dominion over the space it occupies.
prism_stone: A crystal that refuses to let light pass through unchanged.
rainbow: Light, shattered by rain and too proud to reassemble.
acid_rain: Rain that absorbed the grievances of the sky.
wetland: Earth and water, unable to decide who owns the boundary.
thundercloud: A cloud that grew too heavy with its own rage.
earthquake: The earth reminding everything above it who holds the weight.
hurricane: A storm that learned to feed on itself.
swamp: A place where nothing fully lives and nothing fully rots.
bog_spirit: The accumulated resentment of every creature that drowned here.
wasteland: Earth that gave everything it had and was thanked with ruin.
mist: Fog with ambitions of becoming weather.
forest: A congregation of trees old enough to have opinions.
dawn: The moment the dark admits it has lost, again.
eclipse: The sun, briefly interrupted by something with worse intentions.
solar_flare: The sun, losing its temper across a hundred thousand miles.
supernova: A star's final argument, heard across the universe.
black_hole: The place where light goes when it finally loses its way.
starlight: Old light, still travelling because it has nowhere else to be.
constellation: Stars arranged by those who needed the dark to mean something.
dark_matter: The weight of everything the universe refuses to acknowledge.
void_stone: Rock that absorbed the void and learned to be still about it.
quasar: A hunger so vast it shines across the whole sky.
cosmic_dust: The remains of something that was once magnificent.
dusk: The sky preparing to forget the sun.
moonlight: Borrowed radiance, reflected from a borrowed stone.
moonstone: A gem that absorbed the moon's habit of changing its mind.
lunar_curse: The moon's favour, given to those who did not ask for it.
scorched_earth: Soil that will not forgive what was done to it.
time: The one thing that cannot be combined with anything and remain unchanged.
jungle: Forest that decided moderation was an insult.
world_tree: A tree whose roots reach further down than history.
fertile_soil: Ash, persuaded by water to try being useful again.
cinder: What remains when fire finishes its argument but won't quite leave.
bloom: Life insisting on itself despite every reason not to.
lotus: A flower that chooses to grow toward light from the depths of mud.
nightshade: A bloom that borrowed shadow's manners.
flower_crystal: Life and light, frozen in a single moment of agreement.
death_bloom: The last flower — still beautiful, still poisonous.
dark_forest: A forest old enough to have learned not to welcome visitors.
haunted_woods: Trees that remember every name of those who did not leave.
ancient_grove: A place where the trees stopped growing and started watching.
bifrost: A bridge between worlds, burning with every colour that has no name.
niflheim: The cold place beneath all cold places.
chaos: The state that preceded everything and waits patiently for it to end.
order: Chaos, convinced of its own righteousness.
paradox: Two truths that cannot coexist, insisting on it anyway.
entropy: The universe's slow preference for disorder over everything else.
harmony: Multiple things briefly agreeing not to fight.
resonance: The vibration that persists long after the cause has gone silent.
equilibrium: The point where light and dark exhaust themselves into stillness.
oblivion: Darkness without memory — void without meaning.
hellgate: A door no one opened from this side.
void_sea: An ocean where the water was replaced with absence.
dead_land: Earth that remembers being alive and has not forgiven the change.
wraith: Something that refused to stop existing long after it should have.
soul_fire: A flame that burns the part of you that doesn't have a name.
void_water: Fluid that fills the space where water should be.
hollow_earth: Ground that goes deeper than the world does.
basalt: Lava that made peace with the cold and stayed.
onyx: Stone formed where water and shadow both pressed their claim.
umbral_stone: Rock quarried from where the shadow runs deepest.
quicksand: Earth that decided to behave more like water.
desert: Sand that claimed territory while no one was looking.
mirage: Light performing thirst for those who cannot afford to doubt it.
dark_glass: Glass that absorbed shadow and now shows things you did not ask to see.
mirror: Glass that learned the one trick more unsettling than transparency.
void_mirror: A reflection that shows you what stands behind your absence.
glacier: Ice that accumulated patience over ten thousand years.
flood: Water, finally allowed to go wherever it wished.
frost: Ice in its earliest form, still deciding how permanent to be.
ore: Metal, still locked in the grammar of rock.
bar: Ore, persuaded by heat into a more useful shape.
dark_steel: Metal forged in the space between firelight and shadow.
shadow_blade: A blade that cuts even what it cannot reach.
blessed_sword: A weapon that remembers what it was made to protect.
refined_metal: Ore reduced to only what the fire deemed worthy.
mithril: Metal so pure that light passes through it rather than around.
moonblade: A sword forged under moonlight, for wounds that must not heal.
void_steel: Metal tempered in the void — carrying its silence ever since.
pearl: Light, trapped inside the ocean's slow patience.
deep_sea: The part of the ocean never introduced to the sun.
island: Earth that surfaced from the ocean, surprised to find itself above.
coral_reef: Fire from below, sculpted by the sea into something that breathes.
abyss_trench: The ocean's memory of the void beneath it.
volcano: Earth and fire, finding a way out of their disagreement.
hot_spring: The earth breathing warmth up through the cold.
spirit_pool: Water that became a mirror for things without reflection.
oasis: A promise water made to the desert, and kept.
eden: A garden that still remembers what light was for, before we forgot.
kraken: Something ancient from the deep that is mostly hunger and patience.
hidden_oasis: Water that chose to stay secret, for reasons the desert understands.
black_coral: Reef growth from depths where sunlight has never arrived.
sulfur_pool: The earth's digestion, made visible and pungent.
dragon_egg: Contained potential for something that will one day reduce kingdoms to ash.
dragon: Fire, given the ambition to be something far more dangerous.
void_dragon: A dragon that passed through the void and came back changed.
celestial_dragon: A creature of pure radiance, older than the stars it circles.
golem: Clay, persuaded by shadow that it had a purpose.
clay_guardian: A golem that chose its charge and will not be moved from it.
demon: Something from below the world, wearing a shape borrowed for this visit.
fallen_angel: Radiance that traded its wings for knowledge it was told not to seek.
angel_feather: A piece of something sacred, separated from its source.
phoenix_ash: What the phoenix leaves behind before it remembers how to burn.
phoenix: A bird that treated death as a temporary inconvenience.
swamp_beast: A creature that is more swamp than beast at this point.
banshee: The sound grief makes when it forgets it once had a body.
leviathan: The ocean's own nightmare, given scale and appetite.
dark_phoenix: A phoenix that learned from shadow what fire alone could not teach.
archfiend: The thing demons report to, on the rare occasions they report to anything.
stone_sentinel: A guardian so patient it has become indistinguishable from the wall it watches.
dream: The place the mind goes when it needs to lie to itself in comfort.
nightmare: A dream that decided honesty mattered more than kindness.
vision: A dream that carried a message back across the border.
limbo: The place between decisions, where the undecided accumulate.
prophecy: A vision so insistent it began to shape the thing it described.
shadow_crystal: A gem that absorbed shadow until it forgot how to let light in.
void_shard: A fragment of something that used to be more absent than this.
balance: The brief truce between opposing forces, mistaken for peace.
meditation: The practice of becoming quieter than the noise inside you.
rage: The part of hellfire that survives when the rest goes out.
purgatory: A waiting room for the soul, with no clear policy on visiting hours.
transcendence: The moment a thing becomes more than the rules that made it.
awakening: The moment just after the nightmare, when reality feels like relief.
sleep_terror: A nightmare that learned how to wait in the dark.
fated_doom: A destiny composed entirely of endings.
eternity: Time, freed from the requirement to stop.
immortality: Life, persuaded to continue past every reasonable argument against it.
fate: The shape of everything that will happen, pretending to be circumstance.
doom: Fate, with worse manners and no patience for hope.
destiny: A path that was always yours, whether you chose it or not.
past: Everything that happened before this moment, still insisting it matters.
fossil: Life from before this age, preserved in the grammar of stone.
ancient_sea: An ocean so old it remembers the first rain.
endless_void: The void, given room to become everything it always implied.
twisted_fate: Destiny bent back on itself until it became unrecognisable.
elixir: Life condensed into something a person can swallow, if they dare.
dark_elixir: A cure for things that were never meant to be cured.
quintessence: The fifth element — what remains after the other four are understood.
poison: A cure for too much life, applied without consultation.
cure: An argument made against the body's worst decisions.
liquid_fire: Fire made patient enough to wait inside a vessel.
cursed_gold: Wealth that remembers every compromise made to obtain it.
sunstone: Gold that absorbed enough radiance to begin glowing on its own.
molten_gold: Gold returned to honesty by fire.
ambrosia: What divinity tastes like to those permitted to find out.
fire_opal: A gem that caught fire once and decided to keep it.
soul_gem: A vessel for something that did not consent to being stored.
sacred_ground: Earth that was present for something it cannot stop remembering.
unholy_ground: Sacred ground, after it learned what it was standing near.
elysium: A place where the deserving rest — which means it is very quiet.
tartarus: Deeper than the underworld — the place beneath the place of punishment.
venom_flame: A fire that carries its wounds forward into everything it touches.
panacea: A cure for every ailment, except the ones that aren't ailments.
death_potion: The darkest elixir — efficient, thorough, and entirely without sentiment.
pottery: Clay taught by light to hold the shape of usefulness.
cursed_urn: A vessel with something sealed inside it, probably for good reason.
soul_vessel: A container shaped specifically to hold what ordinarily cannot be held.
ruins: What architecture looks like when it runs out of reasons to stand.
stone_tablet: Ancient stone taught to carry language instead of weight.
hallowed_ground: Ruins that received enough prayer to forget what they once were.
catacombs: The city beneath the city, built by the dead for unspoken reasons.
necropolis: A city that filled with the dead and never stopped growing.
altar: Sacred ground shaped by hands into an invitation for something vast.
dark_altar: An altar built for things that do not appreciate the word sacred.
void_temple: A place of worship with nothing at its centre — which is precisely the point.
forbidden_scripture: Words sealed away before anyone understood them well enough to stop reading.
magma: The earth's interior monologue, briefly made audible.
dark_energy: The force that moves everything apart, slowly and without apology.
singularity: A point where all rules arrive and none of them leave.
aurora: Plasma and atmosphere, making something beautiful from a collision.
electric_tide: Water given the manners of lightning and the patience of the sea.
aurora_crystal: A gem that captured the aurora before it could escape.
void_aurora: An aurora that bled through from somewhere with different colours.
pumice: Lava that cooled so fast it forgot to be dense.
volcanic_gem: A crystal born from the moment magma and stone made their truce.
white_hole: The other end of a black hole, opening somewhere no one expected.
null_field: A space where the rules of reality have given up and gone home.
curse: A word spoken at exactly the right moment to do lasting damage.
cleansing: The painful process of removing something that had made itself comfortable.
midas_curse: Gold as punishment — when even abundance becomes insufferable.
lycanthropy: The moon's version of a favour, given without being asked.
hex: A curse in miniature — personal, specific, and deeply petty.
counter_spell: Magic that has learned to read the room.
blight: A curse that spreads through the roots of everything nearby.
purification: The forceful undoing of a corruption that did not want to be undone.
chromatic_burst: Light through a prism, remembering all at once that it was many things.
spectrum: The full argument between light and shadow, laid out in colour.
broken_spectrum: A rainbow interrupted — each colour now going somewhere different.
dissonance: Harmony that disagreed with itself until it broke.
faerie_ring: A circle that predates the word for circle — step inside carefully.
cursed_ring: Something is sealed inside this circle, and it wants out.
frozen_abyss: Cold so absolute that even the void decided to stop moving.
undead_relic: An artefact that refuses to stop working long after its maker did.
cosmic_serpent: A creature that encircles something too large to name.
eternal_phoenix: A phoenix that has died so many times it no longer bothers to count.
prismatic_soul: A soul that contains every colour light can become.
golden_age: The era everyone references and no one actually lived through.
enlightenment: The uncomfortable moment when everything becomes clear at once.
undying: Not immortal — simply unable to finish the process.
ouroboros: The circle that swallows itself and calls it completion.
world_serpent: The serpent at the edge of the map, where the ocean ends.
genesis: The first moment after nothingness decided to try something else.
shadow_wisdom: Knowledge bought with what light could not illuminate.
ascension: The moment a thing becomes more than the weight it was born into.
ragnarok: The end of the gods — catastrophic, inevitable, and somehow still a surprise.
severed_bridge: A connection between worlds, cut from the side with less to lose.
prima_materia: The substance from which everything was made, before it became everything.
creation: The act of arranging the void into something with opinions.
fallen_god: A divine thing brought low by the weight of what it was worshipped for.
eternal_guardian: A sentinel that outlived its charge and chose to remain anyway.
plague: Life's dark mirror — something that spreads by making itself indispensable.
beast_taming: The agreement between wildness and patience, heavily negotiated.
